instructions: Keep one of the five Poke Balls given by the rival after receiving the Pokedex.

instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: ANTIDOTE (100 money total).

items.name: HEART SCALE
instructions: Pick up the hidden Heart Scale on the Route 104 south beach.

items.name: PECHA BERRY
instructions: Harvest a Pecha Berry from the trees on Route 102 or Route 104 south.

items.name: ORAN BERRY
instructions: Harvest an Oran Berry from the trees on Route 102 or Route 104.

items.name: PARLYZ HEAL
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: PARLYZ HEAL (200 money total).

items.name: GREAT BALL
instructions: Keep the Great Ball given by the Devon employee after the Team Aqua battle in Petalburg Woods.

items.name: ETHER
instructions: Pick up the Ether in the northwest corner of Petalburg Woods.

items.name: TM09
instructions: Get TM09 Bullet Seed from the boy south of the Route 104 Flower Shop. Keep the TM; do not teach it.

items.name: CHERI BERRY
instructions: Harvest a Cheri Berry from the trees on Route 104 north.

items.name: LEPPA BERRY
instructions: Harvest a Leppa Berry from the trees east of the Route 104 bridge.

items.name: CHESTO BERRY
instructions: Get the Chesto Berry from the old woman east of the Route 104 bridge.

items.name: SUPER POTION
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: SUPER POTION (700 money total).

items.name: X DEFEND
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: X DEFEND (550 money total).

items.name: PREMIER BALL
instructions: Get the Premier Ball from the boy upstairs in the southwest Rustboro apartment building.

items.name: QUICK CLAW
instructions: Get the Quick Claw from the teacher in Rustboro Trainers' School.

items.name: REPEL
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: REPEL (350 money total).

items.name: X SPECIAL
instructions: Pick up the X Special east of the Rusturf Tunnel entrance on Route 116.

items.name: AWAKENING
instructions: At the Petalburg Mart on the way, buy one each: AWAKENING (250 money total).

items.name: ESCAPE ROPE
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: ESCAPE ROPE (550 money total).

items.name: X SPEED
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: X SPEED (350 money total).

items.name: X ATTACK
instructions: At the Rustboro Mart when you arrive, buy one each: X ATTACK (500 money total).
